Meta.title: Armadero — custom-made wardrobe systems
Meta.description: Handcrafted modular wardrobe systems sized to your room. Ukrainian workshop, warranty up to 5 years.

Catalog.subtitleLine2: your room's size and the amount
Catalog.subtitleLine3: of things you need to store

Technology.intro1: The motorized rail, lighting, and soft-close hinges are all controlled with a single touch — hidden inside the front panel, nothing extra on show.

specs.label: Soft-close hinges
specs.value: Silent closing for doors and drawers

specs.label: Gadgets
specs.value: Wireless charging and an outlet in the drawer

Technology.materialsText: Moisture-resistant chipboard, veneer, and solid wood — every texture is chosen to stay flawless for years. 40+ finish options let you build a wardrobe that looks like it was designed specifically for your room.

Process.heading: How it works, step by step
Process.subtitle: From measuring the room to the finished wardrobe — three simple steps we go through together with you

steps.title: We measure the room
steps.text: Do it yourself with our guide, or have a specialist come measure the space precisely — accounting for every ledge, door, and vent, so the wardrobe fits like a glove, down to the millimeter.

steps.title: You build the configuration
steps.text: Series, number of sections, module layout, finishes and features — all tailored to your interior and budget.

steps.title: You get your finished wardrobe
steps.text: Turnkey manufacturing and installation — we deliver, assemble on site, and show you how to use every mechanism.

Production.detailAlt: A joiner working a wooden beam in the ARMADERO workshop
Production.heading: A workshop, not an assembly line
Production.text: ARMADERO is a team of joiners in Kyiv. Every wardrobe is built to order: a frame in moisture-resistant chipboard or solid oak, hardware from certified European suppliers, hand-assembled, joint to joint. Every mechanism is tested for 50,000 open cycles.

list.name: Olena Kovalchuk
list.text: We ordered a wardrobe for the whole bedroom wall. It arrived in 5 weeks, assembled in a day. Now everything has its place.

list.name: Ihor Tarasenko
list.text: We spent a long time picking the front finish — the ARMADERO team sent samples to our home so we could see the color in person. The result exceeded expectations.

list.name: Maryna Bondar
list.text: The soft-close hinges are silent, the shelf lighting turns on automatically — exactly what was missing. I recommend the Signature series.

list.name: Dmytro Savchuk
list.text: The measuring visit was free and fast. The site's configurator let us see right away what the wardrobe would look like.

list.name: Oleh Petrenko
list.text: We ordered a second module a year later to extend the wardrobe. The color and finish matched perfectly — you can't tell the difference.

list.name: Nataliia Hrytsenko
list.text: We chose the Comfort series — hardware quality on par with imported brands, but with local service and warranty.

list.name: Andrii Melnyk
list.text: Installation was done in one visit, and they showed us how to use the pull-out systems. A year later — no complaints about the mechanisms.

items.q: How much does a measuring visit cost?
items.a: Free within Kyiv. Elsewhere in Ukraine — we confirm the cost with your request, depending on distance.

items.q: Can I order a non-standard wardrobe configuration?
items.a: Yes, the modular system lets you build any layout — from a corner nook to a full walk-in room.

items.q: What's the warranty term for hardware and mechanisms?
items.a: 2 years on soft-close hinges, the motorized rail, and lighting; 5 years on the frame.

items.q: Can I order a wardrobe without lighting and a motorized rail?
items.a: Yes — the Lite series has laminate fronts with standard hardware, no technology package.

items.q: How much does delivery within Ukraine/the EU cost?
items.a: Calculated individually depending on the region and the wardrobe's size.

Privacy.metaDescription: How Armadero collects, uses, and protects the personal data of site visitors and clients.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1body: This Privacy Policy explains how ARMADERO ("we", "the Company") processes the personal data of armadero.ua visitors and clients who submit a request to order a wardrobe system. We follow the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection" No. 2297-VI and other applicable Ukrainian data protection legislation.
Privacy.s2body: Through the request form and the newsletter signup form in the footer, we may collect: your name, phone number, email address, and any message text you voluntarily provide. The site does not use analytics or advertising cookies — the browser's technically necessary sessionStorage is used only to avoid replaying the intro animation within one session, and shares no data with third parties.
Privacy.s3body: Data from the request form is used solely to contact you, discuss your order's details, arrange a measuring visit, and prepare a quote. Data from the newsletter form is used to send news and product roundups about Armadero. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
Privacy.s4body: The basis for processing is the consent you give when filling out the form. Data is retained for as long as needed to fulfill the order and communicate with you, but no longer than 3 years from your last contact, after which it is deleted or anonymized.
Privacy.s5intro: Under applicable law, you have the right to:
s5items: find out whether your personal data is being processed;
access your data and receive a copy of it;
withdraw consent and request deletion of your data;
object to the processing of your data for newsletters at any time.
Privacy.s5outro: To exercise these rights, email us at
Privacy.s6prefix: ARMADERO, 51 Antonovycha St, 01015 Kyiv, Ukraine. Email:

Terms.s1prefix: These Terms govern the use of armadero.ua and the process for submitting a request to have a custom wardrobe system made. By using the site and submitting a request, you agree to these Terms and to our

Terms.s2heading: 2. A request is not a contract
Terms.s2body: The form on the site is a request for a consultation, not a public offer or an electronic contract. After you submit it, we contact you, arrange a measuring visit (free within Kyiv), and confirm the wardrobe's specifications and final price. The manufacturing contract is concluded separately, in writing, after the measurement and specification are confirmed.
Terms.s3body: Prices shown on the site or quoted during a consultation are estimates and depend on the size, materials, and configuration. The final price is fixed in the contract after measuring. Payment terms (deposit/full payment) are agreed individually when signing the contract.
Terms.s4body: The wardrobe frame carries a 5-year warranty; soft-close hinges, the motorized rail, and lighting carry a 2-year warranty, subject to proper use. Because every wardrobe is manufactured individually to the customer's size and preferences, it is subject to the return rules for made-to-order goods of proper quality under Article 9 of the Law of Ukraine "On Consumer Rights Protection": such goods are not subject to return or exchange unless they have manufacturing defects.
Terms.s5body: The site's text, photos, design layouts, and other materials are owned by ARMADERO or used under lawful authorization, and may not be copied or used without written consent.
